name: RES: Renewable Energy Services, Inc
old_description: Building solar power systems with technical expertise for the long-term benefit of our community.
about:
Renewable Energy Services, Inc. (RES) was incorporated in 1992 in Honokaa, on the Big Island of Hawaii. For over three decades the company has focused on bringing solar power to the island community, operating from its base in Honokaa.

RES designs, installs, and maintains both grid-tied and off-grid photovoltaic systems, along with mobile power solutions. The firm also provides troubleshooting, repair, and consulting services, taking a technology-oriented approach that includes vetting equipment and developing performance simulation software to ensure reliable system design.

The company primarily serves residential customers on the Big Island, with long-term clients such as Carolyn Lancaster, who has worked with RES since 2002, and Donald Mott, a client since 2006. Its work emphasizes energy resiliency and local economic benefit for Hawaiian homeowners.

RES distinguishes itself through a commitment to transparency and service that exceeds industry standards. Founded on the belief that solar power is the best electricity source for island communities, the company combines deep local experience with ongoing technical evaluation to deliver systems tailored to Hawaii’s unique conditions.
